name: Spectrum lines
summary: Three traces: the spectrum above, the waveform through the middle, and the spectrum mirrored below.
credit: After the lines in Sonia Boller's audible-visuals (https://github.com/soniaboller/audible-visuals, Apache License 2.0). The idea only; no code ported.
hint: The top trace is the spectrum on a linear axis up to Highest, the middle one the waveform, the bottom one the spectrum again, upside down and running the other way. Classic colours go from white to magenta as a point gets louder.

params.label: Height
params.help: How tall a full spectrum peak stands.

params.label: Spread
params.help: How far the spectrum traces sit from the middle.

params.label: Waveform
params.help: The middle trace's height (0 hides it).

params.label: Colours
params.help: Classic: white going to magenta as a point gets louder. Palette: along the layer's palette by level.
